changes.now: J.A.R.V.I.S.: Just A Rather Very Intelligent System
changes.evidence: The expansion 'Just A Rather Very Intelligent System' is never spoken or shown in Iron Man (or any film); the MCU wiki marks it as conjectural, sourced only to the tie-in Iron Man book. On screen the A.I. is only ever 'J.A.R.V.I.S.'

changes.now: A teenager calling himself Teen frees Agatha Harkness from Wanda's spell and walks the Witches' Road with her.
changes.proposed: A teenager the others call Teen frees Agatha Harkness from Wanda's spell and walks the Witches' Road with her.
changes.evidence: He does not call himself Teen: a sigil (Glamour) hex stops anyone learning his name, so Agatha and the others refer to him as 'Teen' (episodes 1-2).
